title: Zero-shot image-to-PlantUML: a multi-level structural evaluation framework and benchmark
description:
A reproducible benchmark and evaluation framework for reconstructing PlantUML source from a rendered UML diagram image, zero-shot.

The test set holds 1,000 repository-disjoint class and sequence diagrams mined from open-source repositories via World of Code, stratified over four complexity tiers by source-line quartile. Seven multimodal models are evaluated under one frozen prompt at minimum reasoning, all receiving an identical standardized input image. Models are scored on compilation success rate (CSR), Element F1, Relationship F1, UML type accuracy, and chrF++. Every structural metric is reported over two populations: the full 1,000-diagram set with non-compiling predictions scored zero, and the compiled-only subset. Uncertainty is reported as paired bootstrap 95% confidence intervals.

This version adds scorer v2, the structural scorer of the follow-up fine-tuning study, frozen before it scored any fine-tuned model, and the eight stored runs scored again under it. The scorer-v1 results and every number of the paper are unchanged.

The deposition contains the evaluation code with both scorer versions (tags scorer-v1 and scorer-v2), the frozen test-set key list, all model predictions, the computed metric results under scorer v1 (data.zip) and scorer v2 (data_v2.zip), the generated exhibits, the 1,000 standardized test images, and the two extractor JARs the scorers ran with.
